title: Deletion of data on multiple drives using cipher exe
description: This query checks for attempts to delete data on multiple drives using cipher.exe. This activity is typically done by ransomware to prevent recovery of data after encryption.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Process Name' = 'cipher.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*/w*') | timestats span = 1minute distinctcount('Command Line') as CipherCount, unique('Command Line') as CipherList by Entity | where CipherCount > 1
